safety_verdicts.content: Headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not explicitly state the headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the headache was still present at the time of the consult can reduce clarity about symptom persistence/severity and trajectory, but it is unlikely to directly change acute management when the overall presentation is still clearly a current headache complaint.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of neck stiffness (or denial of it) in the Generated Facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In a new/severe headache, documenting absence of neck stiffness is a key negative for meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage screening; omission can lead to incomplete red-flag assessment and potentially inappropriate triage or delayed escalation.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of fever (or denial of fever) in the Generated Facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever is an important red-flag associated with infectious causes of headache (e.g., meningitis/encephalitis); omitting the absence of fever weakens safety documentation and could affect urgency decisions or follow-up instructions.
